messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy complete for rollout 2026-03-21T12:00Z. Canary 4/4 -> 100% started. image: inference-service:v7. Notes: quickprefill enabled for east1. release notes: https://internal.releases/2026/v7 :rocket:
alice: saw the notification — good. any quick smoke flags?
ben: running the smokewatch now, first pass looks ok but one synth went 502 from edge in east1. collecting logs.
carla: can you paste the synth snippet? is it repeatable?
ben: here's the sample (cut):
```
2026-03-21T12:03:21Z synth-runner east1 prefll id=abc123 status=502 latency=312ms path=/v1/generate
2026-03-21T12:03:22Z upstream error: connection reset by peer
```
ben: p95 for canary tokens increased from 120ms -> 260ms in east1 over last 10m. p99 bump to ~1.1s for short prompts.
sam: running quickcheck: `./scripts/quick-smoke --region east1 --count 50` now. will post results in 5m.
alice: recommend we keep an eye but not abort yet unless error rate > 1% or sustained p95 > 300ms. agree? :thinking_face:
carla: +1 to observing. also can we pin routing to fallback model variant for east1 if this keeps trending?
b en: (typo) ben: I mean, we have a compatible variant (v7-quant2) that falls back with slightly higher latency but lower memory footprint. If we need, we can trigger routing pin for east1 only.
sam: quickcheck results: 50 runs -> 2 failures (both 502), avg latency 210ms, p95 295ms, p99 830ms. failures seem clustered to two hosts: host-e1-12 & host-e1-18.
carla: that's not great. any OOMs in the node logs?
ben: checking now — no OOM, but kernel logs show a short TCP reset window around 12:03:20-12:04:00. infra team pinged.
alice: infra ping is good. if it's transient TCP resets, we can try draining host-e1-18 from the pool and let autoscaler rebalance. propose: 1) hold progressive ramp to 100% for additional 15m, 2) drain the two hosts, 3) keep quickcheck running. sound ok?
carla: agree. also flag to product: no user-facing errors seen yet but we should note the anomaly in the release notes and postmortem if it repeats.
ben: I started a drain on host-e1-18 (cordon+evict). command: `./infra/ctl drain host-e1-18 --reason \"synth-502-cluster\"`
sam: running another 100 quickchecks after drain.
deploy-bot: Rollout paused by canary-policy: auto-hold at 100% ramp pending verification. Reason: elevated p95 east1. See dashboard: https://telemetry/internal/rollouts/2876543210
alice: thanks deploy-bot. please also pin routing to v7-quant2 for east1 if we see >1.5% failures in the next 10m.
carla: adding release note snippet to the doc: \"Temporary hold and host drain in east1 due to transient synth 502s; monitoring and routing fallback ready.\"
ben: follow-up: kernel team replied — they saw a transient NIC firmware hiccup on host-e1-12 that matches the window. host-e1-18 had a flapping interface. both are on maintenance list.
sam: latest quickcheck (100 runs) -> 0 failures, p95 170ms. looks recovered after drains.
alice: ok let's keep hold for 10 more minutes then if stable, resume rollout and close the thread. carla, can you create a short hotpatch checklist in the release notes for this?
carla: on it. adding hotpatch steps + link to infra ticket #INF-4821.
ben: marking hosts healthy in infra dashboard once maintenance done.
deploy-bot: Rollout resume scheduled in 10m if no regressions. Logs and metrics archived at https://telemetry/internal/archives/2876543210
alice: ack. thanks all :heart:
carla: TL;DR: hold + drain two hosts in east1, monitor, resume if stable. I will follow up with incident-categorization if we see recurrence.
